[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Complete any open task from capture with a whole-item [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]`!note:block-id`[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A capture item that is exactly `!note:block-id` marks that existing[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]open task Done, exactly as `=x!N` would, but without closing a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pomodoro. In one atomic write it also closes the task's embedded [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]subtasks, retires its Task Links in today's ledger the way `bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]task reconcile` would, and unblocks dependents the way Obsidian's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Ctrl+Enter does. Bulk works one item per blank-line-separated [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]block. In Bob Mac Capture, typing `!` at the start of an item opens[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a "Complete" task picker over every open task in the vault. Tasks [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with Task Links in today's daily note come first, grouped by the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pomodoro they live in. A completion preview shows the struck task, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]its ledger effect, and the tasks it unblocks before Return writes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]anything.[/#D7D7AF]
